request.state: The item I received last week stopped working after only two days of normal use and the display panel now flickers constantly even when it is fully charged, so I think there is a fault with the unit itself.

criteria.billing: Money the customer pays or is owed: invoices, charges, payment methods, refunds, and the price of a subscription.
criteria.shipping: The parcel itself: addresses, delivery dates, a delivery that is late, lost, or damaged, and a return in transit.
criteria.account: Getting into the account and who may use it: signing in, passwords, the email address on the account, permissions, and closing an account.
criteria.product: The thing the customer bought: how it works, a fault in it, a missing part, and the instructions.
criteria.other: Anything that fits none of the four above.
